ContextMenu_MSF_DismantleAllWatches_tt: Dismantles %1 electronic wristwatch(es) from your inventory and nearby containers. Worn watches are excluded. Requires an unbroken screwdriver.
ContextMenu_MSF_DismantleAllWatches_Unav: No eligible electronic watches can be dismantled. Requires an unbroken screwdriver; worn, favorite, or unreachable watches are skipped.
ContextMenu_MSF_DismantleAllWatches_Driv: You cannot dismantle items while driving.
ContextMenu_MSF_DismantleAllWatches_Skip: Unavailable watches (worn, favorite, or unreachable) were skipped.
ContextMenu_MSF_CutAllBelts_tt: Cuts up %1 scrapable belt(s) in your inventory and nearby containers. Equipped, favorite, non-empty, or unreachable belts are skipped. Requires scissors or a sharp knife.
ContextMenu_MSF_CutAllBelts_Unavailable: No eligible belts can be cut up. Requires scissors or a sharp knife; equipped, favorite, non-empty, or unreachable belts are skipped.
ContextMenu_MSF_RipAllClothing_tt: Rips or cuts all %1 tearable/cuttable item(s) nearby or carried. Worn, favorite, or unreachable items are skipped. Cotton is ripped by hand; denim/leather requires scissors or a sharp knife.
ContextMenu_MSF_RipAllClothing_Unavailab: No tearable/cuttable items available. Worn, favorite, or unreachable items are skipped.
ContextMenu_MSF_RipSameClothing_tt: Rips or cuts all %2 %1 item(s) nearby or carried. Worn, favorite, or unreachable items are skipped. Cotton is ripped by hand; denim/leather requires scissors or a sharp knife.
ContextMenu_MSF_RipSameClothing_Unavaila: No eligible %1 can be ripped or cut. Worn, favorite, or unreachable items are skipped.
ContextMenu_MSF_Batch_Driving: You cannot do this while driving.
ContextMenu_MSF_Batch_Skip: Some items could not be processed and were skipped.
ContextMenu_MSF_WashAllCarried_tt: Washes all %1 washable item(s) you are wearing or carrying (clothing, containers, weapons, bandages, etc.). Items are returned to their original container or worn position. Requires about %2 water.
ContextMenu_MSF_WashNoSoap: No soap found; washing will be much slower.
ContextMenu_MSF_GeneratorAddFuelNearby_t: %1 nearby/carried petrol container(s) available; uses the container with the least fuel left first, fills the generator, and returns each container to its original place.
ContextMenu_MSF_GeneratorAddFuelNearby_A: Cannot add fuel while the generator is running.
